content.title: What's the Masters 2026 purse, payout? How much will players make?
content.text: What's the Masters 2026 purse, payout? How much will players make?SEEUPDATE >>Masters 2026 purse, payouts by place released2025 Masters champion Rory McIlroy will tee up to defend his title at Augusta National Gulf Club on April 9.It was McIloy's first Masters win in 17 starts, defeating runner-up Justin Rose in a dramatic playoff.Aside from the iconic green jacket and lifetime invitation, Masters Tournament winners take home a replica Masters trophy, a gold coin and a huge payday.Just how big is the Masters 2026 payout?Here's what to know about the 2026 Masters prize money, purse and how much each player made in 2025:Who won the 2025 Masters?Rory McIlroy won the 2025 Masters Tournament.McIlroy defeated Justin Rose in a dramatic playoff for his first green jacket and career grand slam.Masters 2026 purse, payout, prize money distributionThe Masters has not yet released the purse or payouts for the 2026 Masters. The tournament releases the figures after the Round 2 cut.Masters 2025 payout. How much did Rory McIlroy win?Here's how the record $21 million purse was distributed to players at the 2025 Masters Tournament:(Professional players missing the cut received $25,000 each.
